title: CookieKrumb
features:
1. General

Main Tab:

Auto Click Cookie: Fires the click remote every frame (Heartbeat).

In-Game AutoTap: Toggles and syncs the game's built-in server AutoTap setting.

Auto Roll Cookies: Rolls cookies continuously every frame.

Auto Merge Cookies: Merges all board cookies on a 1-second loop.

Merge All Cookies Once: One-click instant cookie merge.

Auto Rebirth: Automatically rebirths on a 0.5s loop.

Auto Prestige: Automatically prestiges on a 1s loop.

Auto Transcend: Automatically transcends on a 1s loop.

Claim Codes: Automatically redeems all known game codes.

Walk Speed Slider: Custom character movement speed (16–60 studs/s).

Rewards Tab:

Claim All Rewards Once: Instantly claims all 9 playtime gifts and opens all gift boxes.

Auto Claim Free Gifts: Loops every 30s, claiming gifts 1–9 with a safe 1s delay per gift.

Auto Use Gift: Automatically detects and consumes gift boxes as soon as they appear in inventory.

2. Farming

Earth Farm Tab:

Auto Farm (Walk Circle): Continuously walks in a calculated circle around your base cookie with height-snapping and unstuck jumping.

Circle Radius Slider: Adjusts circle size (5–120 studs).

Farm Walk Speed Slider: Custom movement speed while farming (16–60 studs/s).

Enable Free Cookies Trip: Periodically pauses farming, walks to the Free Cookies stand, claims cookies, waits 0.5s, and walks back.

Free Cookies Timer: Sets trip interval (10–60 minutes).

Run Free Cookies Trip Now: Manually tests the Free Cookies trip.

Set Center: Saves your current position as the circle's center.

Teleport to Center / Edge: Quick warps to the center or boundary.

Space World Tab:

Auto Farm Space Cookies: Collects nearby space cookies, stays anchored at the AFK spot, teleports to the Sell Pad when the timer expires, sells cookies, auto-closes the sell GUI, and returns to the AFK spot.

Time Unit Dropdown: Select Seconds, Minutes, or Hours.

Wait Duration Slider: Time spent collecting before selling (1–120).

Space Walk Speed Slider: Movement speed in Space (16–60 studs/s).

Pad Sell Pause Slider: Seconds to stay on the sell pad (0.2s–2.0s).

Teleport to Wait Spot: Warps to the AFK cookie-collecting spot.

Teleport to Sell Pad: Warps directly onto the Space Sell Pad.

Sell Space Cookies Once: Manually triggers a space cookie sale.

World Travel: Instant teleports to Space Dimension or back to Earth Plot.

3. Pets & Hatching

Pets Tab:

Auto Equip Best Pet: Toggles the server's native Auto Equip Best setting.

Equip Best Pets Once: Instantly equips your highest multiplier pets.

Select Egg Stand: Choose between Common, Shiny Common, Rare, Shiny Rare, Jungle, or Shiny Jungle.

Batch Size: Choose 8x (Fastest Turbo), 3x, or 1x.

Hatch Delay Slider: Turbo delay between hatches (0.01s–1.0s, default 0.15s).

Fast Auto Hatch: Bypasses the in-game cutscene animation, anchors to the selected egg stand, and rapid-hatches ~25+ pets/second.

Teleport to Selected Egg Stand: Warps directly in front of the selected egg.

Teleport to Egg Stands: Warps to the egg row corridor.

4. Inventory & Crafting

Items Tab (Boosts):

Master Auto Use Switch: Main power switch (no items are consumed when OFF).

Usage Amount Dropdown: Choose "Use All", "Use 1", or "Use 5".

Auto Use Interval Slider: Check frequency (1–30 seconds).

Auto Use ALL Owned Boosts: Smart mode that continuously consumes any active boost in inventory.

Use All Owned Boosts Once: Manually consumes all inventory boosts right now.
